parameters.query:
SELECT s.id, s.symbol, s.signal, s.confidence, s.price_at_signal,
  (SELECT close FROM market_prices mp WHERE mp.symbol = s.symbol AND mp.timeframe = '1h' ORDER BY mp.open_time DESC LIMIT 1) AS current_price
FROM signals s
LEFT JOIN signal_outcomes so ON so.signal_id = s.id
WHERE so.id IS NULL
  AND s.signal != 'HOLD'
  AND s.created_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
  AND s.price_at_signal IS NOT NULL;
